messages:
Fiona T: Heads-up: we need a rollout plan for the regional fallback policy that accounts for slow client-side flag updates. Customer A flagged it as a showstopper for EU cutover.
Noah P: Can we sketch constraints? mobile has worst-case TTL of 10m, web ~1m. Some older SDKs don't support push.
Lena M: Correct. Also offline-first clients will apply TTL until reconnect. We should avoid relying solely on short TTLs for emergency rollback.
Raj G: Ops preference: prefer server-side routing as our primary control, flags only for UI/feature gating. But we do need fast client-side toggles for immediate UX switches.
Fiona T: Agreed. Proposal: 1) primary control = server routing with immediate effect; 2) client flags used for non-critical UI bits; 3) introduce a "flush" API that forces clients to revalidate on next connect.
Noah P: How would flush API work? push vs long-poll?
Lena M: Implementation idea: control plane writes a flush token per region. SDKs periodically poll token endpoint and compare token; on mismatch trigger immediate refresh. Poll interval configurable. Default poll = 20s for "emergency" flags.
Raj G: That avoids pushing to every client but gives us a fast eventual invalidation path. For mobile battery/net concerns, we should gate this behind an opt-in per-flag.
Fiona T: Good call. Add decision matrix: emergency_flag=true -> token polling 20s + server routing fallback; otherwise default behavior.
Noah P: Telemetry additions: emit flag_poll_token, last_token_check_ts, token_mismatch_count; surface token_mismatch_p95 in console.
Lena M: Canary staging: start with region-level shadow traffic, then server-side 2% routing, then enable token polling for 2% cohort (no UI flip), then client hard flip for selected cohorts. Monitor signals for 2h at each step.
Raj G: Rollback ladder: (A) disable client UI via server-side header, (B) rotate region token (forces revalidate), (C) change server routing to fallback variant, (D) global kill. Make each step reversible and audited.
Fiona T: Customer req: Enterprise Private installs want ability to set token poll interval locally. Add a config knob on on-prem control plane and document security implications.
Noah P: Devex request: we need a small test harness that simulates slow refresh and token mismatch. Suggest a local CLI: "ri-flag-sim --flag regionX --delay 600" to emulate stale clients.
Lena M: Add SDK behavior: if token mismatch occurs more than 3x in a session, SDK should mark flag as "inconsistent" and call diagnostics hook to upload minimal session trace. Helps find SDK/server mismatch bugs.
Raj G: Metrics & gating: block ramp if >0.5% of requests see inconsistent flag decisions or if user-visible error rate increases >0.05% over baseline. Also gate on p99 latency delta < 8%.
Fiona T: Security: flush token rotation must be signed. Add HMAC on token so older on-prem control planes can't be tricked by a rotated token without key.
Noah P: ops-bot/ deploy-bot integration: deploy-bot can emit a signed token rotate event and add an entry to audit log. Should be callable only by 2fa-enabled ops group.
deploy-bot: creating internal RFC ticket: RFC-flag-invalidation-2026, and will stub rotate endpoint (audit + signer).
Fiona T: Action items: Noah - draft token polling spec + SDK opt-in flags (ETA 48h). Lena - add diagnostics hook + inconsistent-flag behavior (ETA 72h). Raj - update rollback ladder doc and gate thresholds (ETA 48h). deploy-bot - create RFC + stub rotate endpoint (ETA 24h).
Noah P: I'll also add console surfaces for token_mismatch_p95 and inconsistent_flag_count.
Lena M: We'll run a dry-run in staging next week with synthetic stale clients and verify canary gating.
Fiona T: Great. We'll reconvene after staging dry-run. Thanks all. :rocket:
